description: RGENTIC provides mission radiation-risk information organised by mission class, lifetime, orbit and architecture. It compares normalised past-mission environments and connects component choices with mitigation considerations. The resource is documented by Vanderbilt University. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The provider supplies a public web description. Licence and any software or data charges are unconfirmed and require provider clarification. The provider warns that its normalised comparisons do not replace mission-specific radiation environments or component testing. Solar-cycle and duration assumptions must be checked. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
